evidenceClass: read-only local source review; no CI execution evidence

sourceReview.entrypoint: The workflow installs Node 22, Go 1.24.x, npm dependencies, and Playwright-managed Chromium, then calls the full default run-compiled-frontend.sh. The script runs the inherited typed-composition gate, sets Go 1.27.3 for the compiled suite, and then invokes compiled-frontend/run.mjs.
sourceReview.launcherRepair: The no-WASM unit tests now call shared chromiumLaunchOptions from conformance/browser.mjs. With no CHROMIUM_PATH they omit executablePath and use Playwright-managed Chromium; WASM assertions remain unchanged. Focused source repair evidence is separate from this full CI run.
sourceReview.buildAndSourcePins: run.mjs records tool versions, commands and logs, pins source files before and after execution, compiles the four apps, verifies every BuildResult-listed generated output by path/bytes/SHA before and after replays, and fails if source pins differ.
sourceReview.generatedDemo: demo/build.mjs composes exactly counter, form, list and effect from each generated gobi-compiled.mjs and encoder.mjs, creates entry.mjs, bundles demo.bundle.mjs, and copies index.html. The demo bundle itself has no output digest field in execution.json, so record extracted asset hashes independently.
sourceReview.httpSmoke: demo/smoke.mjs serves the built artifacts over node:http bound to 127.0.0.1, launches headless Playwright, mounts four sessions, exercises counter Add/Add/Reset and disabled Reset, form text/checkbox/save/literal argument, keyed list edit/reorder, and effect pending/disabled state plus one manual captured reply. It asserts no runtime failures, pageerrors, or .wasm requests, then captures full-page demo.png and writes demo-smoke.json.
sourceReview.errorCaptureLimit: Smoke records pageerror, runtime onFailure, and .wasm requests. It does not separately record console.error, requestfailed, or the navigation response status, and does not expose a dedicated WebAssembly API-attempt counter.
